subject.size_in_frame: head and shoulders, silhouetted, about 0.55 of frame height — she arrives into the frame and stops inside it

headroom: about 0.12 of frame height at the stop, with the low vault of the corner closing above her; the shot ends on that compressed headroom, not on a movement.
horizon_eyeline: Lens low at 1.2 m from the hall threshold: the corner floor runs across at 0.72 of frame height. Her eyeline lifts from the floor to the hall behind camera and comes to rest at 0.44, level, wide.

layers.fg: the edge of the hall threshold stone at the bottom of frame, warm-lit
layers.mg: Alice rounding the corner at a run and pulling up short, mostly silhouette against the dark passage
layers.bg: the dark passage she has come out of, and the pale glimmer of the hall's first lamp pool spilling in from behind camera onto the right of frame

gaze.note: she looks past the lens into the opening hall; about 0.24 of frame width is left open to screen right, toward the hall lamplight, so her look has somewhere to be going when the cut takes us there.

balance: She arrives into the left half and the right half is held empty and faintly lit — the picture is pre-weighted toward the space the next shot will reveal.
leading_lines: The corner's angle makes a hard vertical edge behind her shoulder, and the threshold stone a horizontal under her; the frame is a right angle, and she has stopped inside it.
eye_first: Her stopped face, then the light on the right of frame that stopped it.
constraint_binding: Ends hard on the stop, not on a movement: the composition is designed to settle — the run occupies the first half of the shot and the last frames are a still, balanced, held picture, which is what the cut into the hall reveal needs to land against.
